requires_runtime.browser: optional — only if the `playwright` MCP server is enabled. An installed Edge, Chrome, Firefox or WebKit; nothing is bundled. Not needed on hosts with built-in browser tools (VS Code Copilot).
requires_runtime.notes: The bundled mcp.json invokes `npx -y flint-chart-mcp@^0.3.0` on first tool call; Node 22+ required. First cold start ~1-2s; cached thereafter. Install it to `.vscode/mcp.json` — VS Code does NOT read a workspace-root `.mcp.json`, which is the Claude Code convention; the `servers` schema is identical, and VS Code reports no error because it reads no file at all. The ^0.3.0 pin (bumped from ^0.2.2 on 2026-07-29 when Microsoft corporate npm mirrors caught up) means >=0.3.0 <0.4.0; public npm `latest` is 0.4.0 but has not been verified against this plugin's documented spec patterns from an off-corpnet machine yet. mcp.json also declares two OPTIONAL servers: `replicate` (needed only by the replicate-imagery skill; auth via REPLICATE_API_TOKEN environment variable) and `playwright` (satisfies render-verify's browser capability on hosts with no built-in browser, primarily GitHub Copilot CLI — VS Code heirs omit it).

upstream.notes: Source-of-truth is the upstream OSS repo. Mall vendors a specific version; when upstream tags a new release, Mall automation flags the mismatch. Renamed from flint-chart-plugin on 2026-07-29 and expanded from 3 skills to 8.
